# noust_applications (Data Source)

The applications the token sees, optionally of one team, project, environment or tag. A token bound to a project sees that project's applications and nothing else. Needs the permission `apps.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noust_applications" "staging" {
  team        = "acme"
  environment = "staging"
}

output "staging_domains" {
  value = [for app in data.noust_applications.staging.apps : app.domain]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Only the environments with this slug.
- `project` (String) Only the projects with this slug.
- `tag` (String) Only the applications that carry this tag.
- `team` (String) Only this team's applications.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) The applications, ordered by domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `id` (String) A constant, for Terraform.

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `app_type` (String) The type of application.
- `branch` (String) The branch it is pinned to.
- `domain` (String) The application's primary domain.
- `environment` (String) The environment it belongs to.
- `port` (Number) The port it listens on.
- `project` (String) The project it belongs to.
- `status` (String) The state of the application's unit.
- `team` (String) The team it belongs to.
